notes.note: Rough leader (not Nu/Zeta) realizing this is the Nu/Zeta quest. 'Baka ga' rendered 'Idiot move!' because its target (self or party) is unclear.
Jagd Doga pilot (girl): 0.43/0.46/0.49/0.51/0.52. 0.53 is Nu or Zeta pleading with her (inferred).
Source has no quote brackets on Fin Funnel in 0.46/0.47 (twin did), so quotes dropped there; kept on item-get line 0.56.
Twin speaker is Gaddess, but this scene is the Libra/Epyon one, so the speaker may be Epyon. Wording works either way.
Leader variants 0.4-0.18; the two sentence endings get identical English. 0.7 polite, 0.8 rough.
Remote voices 0.20-0.22 (twin slots are Birth, Accel, Methuss). 0.20/0.21 speakers unconfirmed; 0.22 Methuss, source typo read as in twin.
